channel.title: Austin Daily Herald - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Austin Daily Herald (austindailyherald.com)

item.title: Bruins fall short in shootout
item.description: Austin Bruins rally to tie on Sam Kline’s third-period goal but fall 3-2 in a shootout to the St. Cloud Norsemen on the road.

item.title: Panthers take down Austin boys basketball team
item.description: Austin boys basketball falls 72-64 at Rochester Century; Cole Hebrink scores 23 points in the loss.

item.title: Dahl sets two AHS swim records, Packers advance four to state
item.description: Austin's Brent Dahl breaks two school records and posts an All-American backstroke time as he and three Packers teammates qualify for the boys state swim meet.

item.title: ‘It’s really hard to describe’
item.description: Those documenting ICE activities describe heart-wrenching scenes and warn it may not be over

item.title: PHOTOS: The roar of smashing cancer
item.description: Annual demolition derby keeps up the Paint the Town Pink momentum

item.title: Austin's McRae competes at state gymnastics meet
item.description: Austin sophomore Callie McRae places 48th on beam at the Class AA state meet, her third state appearance, as North/Tartan’s Sydney Johnson wins the event.

item.title: Austin Bruins overwhelm Norsemen in second period of home win
item.description: Five-goal second period powers Austin Bruins past St. Cloud Norsemen 7-1 at Riverside Arena, led by Gavin Hruza’s 5 points and Matsvei Marschanok’s 6.

item.title: Austin wrestlers wrap up season at Section 1AAA meet
item.description: Austin wrestling ends season with nine Section 1AA placewinners in Rochester, led by three third-place finishers and strong depth across the lineup.

item.title: One killed early Sunday morning in Highway 218 crash
item.description: Austin man, 31, dies in early Sunday Highway 218 crash with semi; another person suffers non-life-threatening injuries, with more details expected Monday.

item.title: How to Budget for Your First Car: Beyond the Sticker Price
item.description: A fresh set of wheels marks serious progress.
